actions.action: Mark 越来越多地留宿 Patrick 家（理由是爬楼梯太吃力），但还没搬走；叙述者担心他很快会搬。
actions.anchor: Mark had started staying over at Patrick’s more and more.

actions.action: Mark 与 Patrick 开始交往，时间与叙述者开始和 Claude 交往同期；叙述者一直想介绍 Claude 给 Mark 但没找到机会。
actions.anchor: Mark and Patrick started seeing each other around the same time I started seeing Claude.

actions.action: 叙述者趁 Mark 在家、在厨房餐桌写日记时坐下，脱口说出她见过 François。
actions.anchor: Mark was writing in his journal at the kitchen table when I sat down and blurted it out.

actions.action: Mark 合上笔记本、沉默一分钟，起身放了一张唱片《Marquee Moon》。
actions.anchor: He got up and put a record on. Marquee Moon.

actions.action: Mark 坐在地板上抱膝、紧绷后摊成 X 形，问叙述者是否问过那些死者「怎么知道自己死了」。
actions.anchor: have you ever asked them how they know they’re dead?

actions.action: 叙述者用「鬼魂的感受多于它们所知道的」作答；Mark 呻吟、双眼紧闭，反问为什么要把这事告诉他。
actions.anchor: Why would you tell me this?

actions.action: Mark 起身拔唱针，说要去 Patrick 家，此后没有回家。
actions.anchor: He got up and cut the needle, said he was going to Patrick’s, and he didn’t come home.

actions.action: 次日叙述者打电话留言：承认不该说那话，约一起去散步。
actions.anchor: The next day, I called and left a message

turning_point.text: 叙述者把「见过死后的 François」说出口，Mark 不再只是「越来越常住 Patrick 家」，而是当场离开去了 Patrick 家并不再回来——本章是叙述者失去 Mark 的节点。
turning_point.anchor: He got up and cut the needle, said he was going to Patrick’s, and he didn’t come home.

relationships.note: Mark ↔ Patrick：恋人/越来越认真，Mark 越来越多住他家并最终离开去他那里。
relationships.anchor: Mark was getting serious about Patrick

relationships.note: 叙述者 ↔ Claude：叙述者开始了新的感情（与 Mark–Patrick 同期），但尚未介绍给 Mark。
relationships.anchor: I was starting to have feelings for someone new

relationships.note: 叙述者 ↔ Mark：同居的伴侣关系正在瓦解；叙述者说「我在失去 Mark」，却没能说出怕失去他。
relationships.anchor: I wish I had just told him that I was scared of losing him.

relationships.note: François ↔ Mark：François 也是 Mark 的朋友（不只是叙述者的）。
François ↔ 两人（共同记忆）：François 教过他们法语动词 déranger（被烦扰/不便）。
relationships.anchor: you use the verb déranger to mean bothered or inconvenienced

relationships.note: Mark ↔ Marky Moon：Mark 偶尔穿的银色舞会裙与他的变装名 Marky Moon。
叙述者 ↔ 亡者（François 等）：叙述者见过很多死去的朋友，只对 Mark 说了 François。
relationships.anchor: I told Mark about François’s showing up on our fire escape

numbers_dates.note: 次日（章节内唯一成规模的日期推进）
numbers_dates.anchor: The next day, I called and left a message

numbers_dates.note: 叙述者前一晚见过 François
numbers_dates.anchor: I had seen François the night before and I couldn’t get him out of my mind.

numbers_dates.note: 她早上醒来发现 Mark 在家
numbers_dates.anchor: when I woke up in the morning
didn’t say anything for a minute

numbers_dates.note: Mark 住 Patrick 家的频率递增
numbers_dates.anchor: Mark had started staying over at Patrick’s more and more.

numbers_dates.note: 两段关系开始的时间重合
numbers_dates.anchor: around the same time I started seeing Claude
